title: STATE 291027: Decay of Rocket Body, Cosmos 1873, September 17, 1987
doc_notes: This document is a Department of State cable regarding the decay of the Soviet rocket body Cosmos 1873 and its likely correlation to reported sightings in Barbados.

incidents.summary: Sightings of up to seven unidentified objects moving at high speed near Grantley Adams International Airport and the surrounding region.
incidents.explanation: U.S. Space Command reported the decay of the spent rocket body of the USSR's satellite, Cosmos 1873, which likely accounts for the sightings.
incidents.quote: SIGHTINGS WERE MADE ON 1 SEPT., SHORTLY AFTER 8:30 P.M. LOCAL TIME.
